text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan spent every day having a 
blast with her newly made gyaru friends.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing everyone cheer for me is kind of 
ticklish... but it feels so good. It 
naturally brings a bright smile to my 
face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, joint training with Trainer 
Kiryuin and others was held. She found 
herself unable to keep up with the 
high-level discussions taking place there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although she managed to deal with it 
thanks to the Trainer's explanation... 
Tosen Jordan murmured softly to herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"...If I could really understand your 
strategy, would I be able to get even 
stronger, too?"
